D. C. (Special Branch).
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No.__________
C. B. H. Q. C.8 Station____
REPORT
Date Dec. 5, 1938.
Subject ASSISTANCE TO JAPANESE MILITARY.
Made by D. S. BRADLEY Forwarded by D. I. GLOVER

Sir,

At 5.30 p.m. 4.12.38, D.S.I. Umemoto attached to the
S.P.O. reported to C.B.H.Q. that Warrant Officer Shimowatari
of the Japanese Military Police required assistance to arrest
a male Chinese in the International Settlement, as the Chinese
was a fugitive from Sungkiang where he was wanted by the
Garrison Commander for taking part in Anti-Japanese activities.

The necessary assistance was given and at about 6.45 p.m.
4.12.38 detectives arrested a male Chinese named Kau Kiu Zeh
(高久?), 50, Sungkiang, M/Unemployed, resident of Sung-
kiang, in the Chien Shan Lodging House, Hankow Road, where
he was attending a wedding party.

When the suspect was arrested, he admitted that he
had only arrived in Shanghai from Sungkiang on the after-
noon of 3.12.38 and had opened rooms 50 and 32 at the Soo
Teh (??) Lodging House, Chekiang Road. He also admitted
that he was the person whom the Sungkiang Authorities referred
to.

His rooms at the Soo Teh Lodging House were searched, but
nothing of an incriminating nature was found there.

The Japanese Military Police requested the immediate
handing over of the suspect, but they were informed that
it would be advisable for them to return on the morning of
5.12.38 to C.B.H.Q. and produce all the evidence they had
acquired against him before he was handed over.

Warrant Officer Shimowatari agreed to this suggestion
and he will return to C.B.H.Q. as suggested and make further
representations for the handing over.

Kau Kiu Zeh states that the reason for his being wanted

D. C.（特别处）。
上海公共租界工部局警务处。
档案号___
中央捕房总部 C.8 警区____
报告
日期：1938年12月5日。
事由：协助日本军方。
具报人：D. S. BRADLEY 转呈人：D. I. GLOVER

敬启者：

1938年12月4日下午5时30分，配属至上海警察总局（S.P.O.）的特别调查员梅本（Umemoto，音译）向中央捕房总部报告称，日本宪兵下士官下渡（Shimowatari，音译）要求协助在公共租界内逮捕一名中国男子，因该男子系松江逃犯，松江卫戍司令因其参与反日活动而对其通缉。

警方提供了必要协助，约于1938年12月4日下午6时45分，侦探在汉口路钱山旅馆（Chien Shan Lodging House，音译）逮捕了一名名为高久泽（Kau Kiu Zeh，音译）的中国男子，50岁，籍贯松江，职业无业，居住于松江，当时他正在该处参加婚礼宴会。

嫌疑人被捕时承认，他仅于1938年12月3日下午从松江抵达上海，并在浙江路的苏德旅馆（Soo Teh Lodging House，原文不清）开设了50号和32号房间。他还承认自己就是松江当局所指之人。

警方搜查了他在苏德旅馆的房间，但未发现任何具有罪证性质的物品。

日本宪兵要求立即移交嫌疑人，但被告知他们最好于1938年12月5日上午返回中央捕房总部，并在移交之前出示他们所掌握的针对该嫌疑人的所有证据。

下士官下渡同意此建议，他将按建议返回中央捕房总部，并就移交事宜作进一步交涉。

高久泽称，松江当局通缉他的原因
